Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 27-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Ethical hacking and cyber security [IT_4024]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                     Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Analyze how ethical hacking differs from malicious hacking and how intent defines legality.           (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                         Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Analyze the effectiveness of port-scanning tools (Nmap, Unicorn Scan) in identifying open services (5)  
  in a network.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Analyze how null sessions and weak authentication contribute to privilege escalation attacks in       (5)  
  Windows systems.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Analyze how tools like DumpSec and Hyena simplify enumeration and risk discovery in enterprise        (5)  
  networks.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
3)                Examine the impact of delayed patching on zero-day vulnerability exploitation.                        (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                         Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Analyze how poor database connectivity security leads to injection and credential-leak issues in      (5)  
  web servers.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)                Analyze the importance of penetration-testing tools such as Burp Suite and OWASP ZAP in web           (5)  
  application security assessment.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Examine and alalyze how phishing and spyware attacks compromise user credentials and analyze          (5)  
  defense strategies.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
5)                Examine and analyze the role of cyber forensics in tracing digital evidence in cybercrime             (5)  
  investigations.  
  
  Page #1

A)                                                              Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)                Analyze the ethical and legal implications of hacking for defensive purposes under Indian cyber      (5)  
  law.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"
